snippet.title: ♾️ Infinity Nikki Version 2.3 PV | Uncrowned Heart
snippet.description:
♾️ Infinity Nikki Version 2.3 PV | Uncrowned Heart

Some say idols are the very definition of perfection. Others believe it's the brilliance of their heart that makes them truly shine.
A grand coronation celebration unfolds for Spira's very own Charisma Star—Angelina Kaleidostar Roucoco!
And yet... is our "perfect idol" truly as perfect as she seems?

Infinity Nikki Version 2.3 "Uncrowned Heart" launches on March 2 (UTC-7)!
Get ready for the exclusive quest "Uncrowned Heart," explore the Sugarbloom Isle, try the new permanent Expansion feature, and enjoy exciting gameplay updates and reward events! Stylists, don't miss out—jump in and discover all the fun!

—— 
➤ Infinity Nikki Version 2.3 Uncrowned Heart launches globally on March 2 (UTC-7)!
